response_ms_tool_median.note: user finished to first sample heard, turns that called a tool

response_ms_no_tool_median.note: same, turns answered from the standing context alone

advance_ms_median.note: spoken advance to the next step beginning

tool_silence_ms_max.note: longest gap before anything was heard on a tool turn

status_dropped_pct.note: statuses dropped because the answer was ready first

interrupt_stop_ms_median.note: user speech onset to audio stopping, measured at the listener

steps_presented.note: steps handed to the model to say

replies_heard_pct.note: model replies that finished without being cut

provider_failures.note: with no pedal there is no fallback path, so this is reported
